target_customer: Patients with major depression, Alzheimer's and Parkinson's disease treated with home neuromodulation; paid by patients or health systems
problem: Transcranial magnetic stimulation is FDA cleared for depression but limited to hospitals because of device cost and complexity. Actipulse builds a proprietary device for home treatment.
business_model: Medical device, regulated, requires clinical trials and clearance before sales

founders.name: Adrien Châtillon
previous_startups: 3+ earlier startups, names not given on YC page
founders.background_notes: YC page says he lived and worked in more than 8 countries.

founders.name: Gabriel Villafuerte
education: MD/PhD in neuroscience (institution not stated on YC page)

technical_complexity.rationale: A novel magnetic pulse device needs hardware, clinical evidence and FDA clearance, which is research and regulatory grade work.

defensibility.rationale: Clinical data and device clearance are slow to replicate, though clinical benefit is not demonstrated in sources.

market_need_then: Depression is common and hospital TMS access is limited, which the company cites; dated spend evidence was not found.

branding.domain_note: Uses actipulseneuroscience.com, a long descriptive domain.

identity.voice_and_tone: Ambitious: aims to become the golden standard of neuromodulation

branding.community_and_virality: Prix Galien nomination for best medical startup in 2024 per YC page; WebMD article on at-home stimulation in October 2024 appeared in search results but was not opened.

brand_strength.rationale: Descriptive science brand with some award recognition, long name, low consumer awareness.

outcome_analysis: Actipulse is active with 38 people and describes a pivotal depression trial, after a 2021 crowdfunding raise and YC in Winter 2022. A third party directory says no FDA marketing authorization or US trial registry entry was found and that an earlier Alzheimer's trial's primary endpoint was safety, so commercial proof is still open and the timeline appears to have slipped. Funding is partially known.
notes: Republic page shows 200,390 USD raised, SAFE at a 10M USD cap, close 2021-11-17; the cap is not a post-money valuation so none recorded; PR Newswire confirms the public raise targeting 1.2M. Total funding figures from aggregators (500K, 740K, 1.23M) conflict and are unverified. Location differs: YC says Mexico City, company site and other sources say Paris and Cambridge MA. healthcarediscovery.ai is a critical third party directory. No dated competitor sources found, so list is empty.
